Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adult 18 years old or older
  -  Have a child age  [AND] 3-18 that was hospitalized overnight with a traumatic brain injury (TBI)
-  Involved in the care and support of the child with the TBI

right.raw_text: -  Live in the same household as child with a TBI

left.raw_text: -  The child with the TBI is able to follow simple instructions such as "please eat your toast

right.raw_text:
"
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Does not speak and read English

left.raw_text: -  Does not have high speed Internet access
